## Activity

During March 2019, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 79 captures. This represents the site’s activity for the month and provides the overall volume against which image quality and grading outcomes are reported. The capture total is presented without adjustment or further breakdown.

## Image quality

Of the 79 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.5. This measure records the proportion of captures for which grading could not be completed and should be considered alongside the overall activity total for Oakridge Primary Care during March 2019.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results during the month. The median lag was 7. This is the median interval reported for grading activity associated with the 79 captures completed at Oakridge Primary Care in March 2019. Together, the referable result count and median lag summarise the grading position for the reporting period.
